text: A platform at each of Telok Blangah and HarbourFront stations will be closed temporarily for Circle Line works.
One platform at each of Telok Blangah and HarbourFront will close from 20 January to 24 May 2024 for Circle Line Stage 6 track works.
Circle Line services will resume normal operations from 6 April 2024 after rail expansion works completed ahead of schedule.
